# Grant Program Website - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
A static HTML/CSS/JavaScript website for promoting and managing a grant program. The site includes information pages, grant details, and an application form.

## Project Structure
- `index.html` - Home page with welcome and overview
- `about.html` - About the grant program
- `grants.html` - Details of available grants
- `apply.html` - Grant application form
- `contact.html` - Contact information
- `css/styles.css` - Main stylesheet
- `js/main.js` - Navigation and form handling
- `assets/` - Images and other media

## Development Notes
- Use vanilla JavaScript for interactivity
- Forms are client-side validated
- No backend required for basic functionality
- All pages are responsive and mobile-friendly
